test_click_lpr_navigation.title: Navigate to LPR then to Views page and verify page loaded

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The LPR Lists page opens and shows the Create List button.

steps.action: Click Views in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The Views page opens and shows a titled view tab.

test_create_multiple_views.title: Create multiple view tabs by clicking view plus button

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, click LPR, then click Views in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The Views page opens with its view tabs and a plus tab.

steps.action: Count the view tabs, then click the plus tab.
steps.expected: One new view tab appears next to the existing tabs.

test_close_all_views_with_popup.title: Close views down to the last one, which refuses with an alert

steps.action: Click Views in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The Views page opens with its view tabs.

steps.action: Click the close icon on the last tab. Repeat until one tab remains.
Click the close icon on the last remaining tab.
steps.expected: An alert reads Action not permitted and the tab stays open.
